QuestInfo.name: Doodles of the Past 2
QuestInfo.0: Old doodles found in #b#m401040400##k... Why did you make such doodles?
QuestInfo.1: You doodled on the wall, writing codes to find the secret hideout. The secret hideout indicated by the doodles is in the #bvalley outside downtown#k for sure. You should go there.
QuestInfo.2: You found an old chest in the secret hideout. This is where you placed your valuables... Now, they should be forgotten.

0.msg: #b...Yes, I made these doodles, writing codes on the wall to find the secret hideout. Haha. Now I remember.

1.msg: #bI remember for sure after seeing the doodles. My secret hideout must be...in the valley outside downtown.

2.msg: #b...I wonder if it's still there. Should I go?

0.msg: #bThis is all a waste of time. I should stop.
(It's an old chest filled with the treasures of your youth. Memories flood back as you go through its contents.)

1.msg: #bHeh... It's all my old stuff. My slingshot, my old wooden sword... I used to practice for hours with this.

2.msg: #bI thought I was so tough back then. Ha... What a brat I was.

3.msg: #b...What's this? A bouquet and a letter? These aren't mine...

4.msg: #bTo... Mother? I was going to surprise her with this. The day before...it happened...

5.msg: #b(Even after all these years, the scent of the flower fills the box.)#k

6.msg: #b...N-no. No more looking back. I promised myself I'd only look forward from now on.

0.msg: #bI need to get out of here. There's still more work to do!
